units.aura-avatar-ui.service:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-avatar-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA cached avatar touchscreen interface
Wants=xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
After=local-fs.target xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
RequiresMountsFor=/home/root/aura-voice-barge-in-20261020/candidate-667b70d586ca/runtime
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
Environment=DISPLAY=:0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-voice-barge-in-20261020/candidate-667b70d586ca/runtime/aura
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-voice-barge-in-20261020/candidate-667b70d586ca/startup/launcher.py --config /home/root/aura-voice-barge-in-20261020/candidate-667b70d586ca/startup/config.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=25
KillMode=mixed
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=aura-avatar-ui

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target

units.aura-camera-ui.service:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-camera-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA shared USB camera preview and YOLOX person adapter
After=local-fs.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-handsfree-dialogue-20261020/candidate-0c0a8ab46ec2/runtime/aura/tools/board_camera_motion.py --config /home/root/aura-handsfree-dialogue-20261020/candidate-0c0a8ab46ec2/camera_live_config/board_camera_ui.json
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-handsfree-dialogue-20261020/candidate-0c0a8ab46ec2/runtime/aura
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.xserver-nodm.service:
# /lib/systemd/system/xserver-nodm.service
[Unit]
Description=Xserver startup without a display manager
StartLimitBurst=5
StartLimitIntervalSec=100

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/xserver-nodm
User=root
ExecStart=/etc/xserver-nodm/Xserver
Restart=always

[Install]
Alias=display-manager.service
